# DSA Vault

> An AI-assisted DSA (data structures & algorithms) interview trainer built on the Striver's A2Z DSA Sheet. A Socratic AI coach runs entirely through the user's own Claude subscription (Pro, Max, or Code) — no API key, no usage added by the product itself.

## What it is

- Full Striver's A2Z DSA Sheet, indexed and searchable, with working Java solutions.
- A Socratic coach chat: the learner describes their own intuition before seeing any solution write-up.
- Converts any solution into whichever language the learner actually interviews in.
- Grades a learner's own practice attempt against the reference solution (not just pass/fail on test cases).
- Generates a visual, step-by-step dry run of an algorithm executing.

## Pricing

One-time payment, ₹199 (INR). Lifetime access — not a subscription, no recurring charge.

## Requirements

Requires the buyer's own Claude Pro, Max, or Code subscription, runnable non-interactively from a terminal. This product is the workflow layer only — it does not provide AI usage, API access, or model credits of its own.

## How access works

1. Buyer signs in with GitHub (no separate account/password).
2. Buyer pays once via Razorpay.
3. A GitHub collaborator invite is sent automatically to a private repository containing a compiled build (not the product's source code).
4. Buyer clones that repository and runs `node start.js`, which asks for a one-time GitHub sign-in to confirm the license, then starts a local web app on `localhost:3000`.

Licensing is enforced live against GitHub collaborator status — it is not transferable to another GitHub account.
